description: Get a topic area, its membership and link, and its glossary entries. ID-only requests return all entries in full. Adding detail, limit, or cursor enables pages (25 default, 100 maximum); detail defaults full. total counts the full topic. Use list_categories to discover IDs and get_term for a full entry.

cursor.description: Copy nextCursor from the previous page and keep the same tool, filters, and detail. Omit it on the first request; restart without it after INVALID_CURSOR. The final page has no nextCursor.

detail.description: "full" returns complete entries (default); "compact" returns summaries with links.

id.description: Topic ID from list_categories, for example "ai-and-automation" or "cloud-and-systems".

limit.description: Entries per page: default 25, maximum 100. May change between pages.

name: get_category
title: Get topic area
